# UI Style Kit CSS

> CSS-only visual style and theme preset library with 20 UI systems, 25 color themes, native HTML styling, copyable theme overrides, and shared `--usk-*` color roles.

## Primary URLs

- Live demo: https://foscat.github.io/ui-style-kit-css/
- GitHub: https://github.com/Foscat/ui-style-kit-css
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/ui-style-kit-css
- Wiki: https://github.com/Foscat/ui-style-kit-css/wiki
